prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1023; do not mention it.)
text:
Re: Claim on behalf of [CLIENT_NAME]

Please accept this letter as formal notice that our office represents [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was operating a vehicle that was struck head-on by your insured's vehicle while traveling at a low rate of speed. Despite the modest nature of the impact, our client sustained a concussion, which has resulted in persistent headaches, dizziness, sensitivity to light, and difficulty concentrating. Our client has been under the care of a physician and has missed substantial time from work as a direct result.

Liability in this matter is clear. Your insured failed to maintain control of the vehicle and crossed into our client's lane, and the available evidence, including the police report and vehicle damage photographs, supports that conclusion. We do not anticipate a serious dispute over fault.

Accordingly, we demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this collision. This demand is available for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice to your company. Please direct all future communications regarding this matter to my office.
